comment: Phase 28 baseline harmonic-richness ratios. Each value is Σ E(k·f₀ for k in 2..8) / E(f₀) computed via Phase29Fft.HarmonicRichnessRatio over 1.0 sec of rendering at 44.1 kHz, 120 BPM (= 2 beats). Phase 29 Plan 05 must show ≥ 1.20 × these values per instrument (REQ-6 / SPEC D-23).
baseline_method: Goertzel @ k·f₀ for k in 1..8, summed energy above ÷ energy at f₀
